# Night-time light per hexagon: #   ntl_2014: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2014
#   ntl_2015: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2015
#   ntl_2016: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2016
#   ntl_2017: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2017
#   ntl_2018: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2018
#   ntl_2019: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2019
#   ntl_2020: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2020
#   ntl_2021: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2021
#   ntl_2022: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2022
#   ntl_2023: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2023
#   ntl_2024: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2024
#   ntl_2025: mean radiance on the hexagon's land in 2025
#   ntl_change_pct: (ntl_late - ntl_early) / (ntl_early + 1) x 100; the +1 keeps dark cells from blowing up
#   ntl_trend_pct_per_year: growth per year from a straight-line fit of log(radiance + 1) over 2014-2025

2014-2025 (VIIRS annual composites): so each hexagon covers about 4 pixels and neighbors share values.
